items.author: ChristopherLeee
items.descZh: agentmiddleware 是一个面向 AI 代理的中间件网关，旨在为代理调用高风险工具（如退款、付款、部署）提供安全管控。其核心功能是引入“签名许可”机制，确保每次工具调用都需经过授权，并且同一请求密钥最多只执行一次，从而防止重复扣款或重复操作。系统在每次操作后生成可离线验证的签名收据，确保操作的可审计性与不可否认性。该项目目前处于预发布阶段，由个人维护，未发布至 PyPI 或 npm，需从源码安装。其亮点在于将金融级的幂等与审计能力以轻量中间件形式嵌入代理工作流，适用于需要严格控制代理行为的场景。用户可通过 3 分钟快速体验其提供的托管演示或本地部署网关进行验证。
items.quote: 一次派发，一次计费，可离线验证。

items.title: Show HN: Statement Proof – PDF bank statement to CSV, proved or refused
items.desc: description: Converts a PDF bank statement to CSV, then checks it against the statement's own balances. If it doesn't add up you get told which row, not a file to trust. title: Bank statement PDF to CSV, proved against the balances image: https://statementproof.quillnow.com/og.jpg Statement Proof Converts a PDF bank statement to CSV — and proves the result against the statement's own balances. If it doesn't add up, you get told which row, not a file you'd have trusted. Drop a PDF here or click to choose Nothing is stored. The file is read in memory and discarded. A statement that doesn’t add up Any converter looks good on a clean statement. This is the one that separates them — [download it](/examplebrokenstatement.pdf)and put it through anything you like, including this. DATE DESCRIPTION PAID OUT PAID IN BALANCE 03/04/2026 TESCO STORES 3456 25.00 975.00 14/04/2026 SALARY ACME LTD 10.50 985.50 25/04/2026 RENT DD 80.25 915.25 985.50 − 80.25 = 905.25\. The statement prints 915.25\. Every value on its own is perfectly plausible; only the arithmetic disagrees. That is exactly what a misread looks like, and it is invisible to anything that only reads the page. Drop it in above and you get told _“Row 3 does not agree with the balance printed beside it on the statement”_ — and no CSV, because there is no correct CSV to give you. We put this same file through two other converters. Both returned a CSV. One of them displayed “all checks passed”, and the CSV it produced contained an amount that appears nowhere on the statement. We are not naming them, because the file is right there — check for yourself. [How to check a bank statement conversion is correct](/verifybankstatementconversion) — the three checks, the spreadsheet formulas, and what each one cannot catch. json { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "SoftwareApplication", "name": "Statement Proof", "url": "https://statementproof.quillnow.com/", "applicationCategory": "FinanceApplication", "operatingSystem": "Web browser", "description": "Converts a PDF bank statement to CSV and proves the result against the statement's own opening, closing and running balances, refusing rather than returning a CSV that does not add up.", "offers": { "@type": "AggregateOffer", "priceCurrency": "GBP", "lowPrice": "5", "highPrice": "15", "offerCount": "2" } }
items.author: f2002119
items.descZh: Statement Proof 是一款专为银行对账单处理设计的工具，旨在解决 PDF 转换 CSV 时可能存在的准确性问题，背景源于对财务数据验证的高需求。其核心功能是将 PDF 格式的银行对账单转换为 CSV 文件，并通过比对对账单自身的期初、期末和运行余额来证明转换结果的正确性。亮点在于能精确检测算术不一致，例如在测试案例中，当一行余额计算为 905.25 但对账单打印为 915.25 时，工具会明确指出“Row 3 does not agree with the balance printed beside it on the statement”，而不返回错误 CSV；性能上，它采用内存处理模式，文件不存储，确保数据安全，且价格区间为 GBP 5 到 15，提供两个选项。适用场景包括财务审计、数据验证等需要高准确性的领域，特别适合处理复杂或可能损坏的对账单。
items.quote: 将 PDF 银行对账单转换为 CSV，并根据对账单自身的余额对结果进行验证。

[](https://pypi.org/project/univo/) [](https://github.com/leopoldch/univo/blob/main/pyproject.toml) [](https://github.com/leopoldch/univo/blob/main/LICENSE) pip install univo from univo import Finder names = ["Northwind Traders", "Contoso", "Northwnd Traders", "NORTHWIND TRADERS", "Fabrikam"] for match in Finder().find(names, min_score=0.8).matches: print(names[match.left_id], "~", names[match.right_id], round(match.score, 2)) Northwind Traders ~ NORTHWIND TRADERS 1.0 Northwind Traders ~ Northwnd Traders 0.94 Northwnd Traders ~ NORTHWIND TRADERS 0.94 No training and no API key: records never leave your machine. By default, find returns up to 1,000 matches scoring 0.8 or more (limit, min_score), and text is compared by spelling. Text(mode="semantic") compares by meaning, with a local model: the 15 MB multilingual default, or any [Model2Vec](https://github.com/MinishLab/model2vec) model from Hugging Face or a folder. More: [choosing a mode](https://github.com/leopoldch/univo/blob/main/docs/guide/quickstart.mdchoosingatextmode), [choosing a model](https://github.com/leopoldch/univo/blob/main/docs/guide/models.mdchoosingamodel), [every option](https://github.com/leopoldch/univo/blob/main/docs/guide/quickstart.mdlimitsandreports). Built for data cleaning, entity resolution, ML dataset deduplication and realtime duplicate checks. Records and rules A schema says which fields to compare, how, and which differences rule out a match. Nested fields are reached by path. from univo import Exact, Finder, Schema, Text schema = Schema( id_field="id", fields={"name": Text(), "address.city": Text(), "vat": Exact(conflict="reject")}, ) finder = Finder(schema=schema) finder.add( [ {"id": 1, "name": "Northwind Traders SAS", "address": {"city": "LYON"}, "vat": "FR401"}, {"id": 2, "name": "Northwind Traders", "address": {"city": "Lyon"}, "vat": "FR999"}, ] ) query = {"id": 3, "name": "Northwind Traders", "address": {"city": "Lyon"}, "vat": "FR401"} for match in finder.search(query).matches: print(match.right_id, round(match.score, 2), match.reasons) 1 0.94 ['name: trigrams', 'address.city: edit_distance', 'vat: exact'] Recor
items.author: jweaz
items.descZh: Univo 是一款专为 Python 生态打造的轻量级、本地化数据清洗与实体解析工具，旨在通过高效的模糊匹配技术帮助用户快速识别并清理重复记录，确保数据集的清洁与准确。在核心功能上，它支持对字符串、结构化记录及深度嵌套对象进行比对，融合了拼写相似度、本地语义嵌入（支持 15MB 多语言默认模型或自定义 Model2Vec 模型）以及用户自定义的字段级 Schema 规则。其亮点在于完全本地化的运行机制，无需 API 密钥且数据绝不外泄，默认配置下可快速返回评分在 0.8 以上的最多 1000 条匹配结果，并支持通过路径精准定位嵌套字段及配置复杂的冲突解决策略（如精确值冲突拒绝）。通过简单的 Finder 和 Schema 接口，工具能智能返回每条匹配的具体比对依据（如 trigrams 或 edit_distance），极大降低了复杂数据去重的开发成本。该工具特别适用于数据清洗、机器学习数据集去重、跨源实体解析以及需要高隐私保护的本地实时重复数据检测场景。

items.descZh: 该工具源于开发者在黑客马拉松中的创意，旨在将健身融入日常编程工作。其核心功能是提供便捷的俯卧撑记录与引导，并已全面转为免费模式，新增了Apple Watch应用以提升使用便利性。亮点在于其强大的社区驱动力，开发者们已累计完成了约4万次俯卧撑，展现了极高的参与度。原本该工具采用免费增值策略以竞争RevenueCat的Shipaton 2025，如今所有功能均免费开放。此产品特别适合需要利用工作间隙进行碎片化身体锻炼的科技从业者。
items.quote: 去年我为黑客马拉松开发了这个工具，自那时起，我和其他开发者在工作日已经做了约 4 万个俯卧撑。
items.titleZh: GitPushups：如果你在工作时间没做俯卧撑，它就会阻止你提交代码。

items.author: SurfingAlpaca
items.descZh: 针对市场上现有 VS Code 衍生平台（如 Conductor 和 Orca）在功能或体验上未能达到预期痛点，作者自主研发了一款全新的开发工具平台。该产品作为一款 VS Code 衍生版本，继承了 VS Code 强大生态的同时，针对开发者核心工作流进行了深度重构与优化。其核心亮点在于打破了传统衍生平台的局限，提供了更具灵活性和高效性的开发环境，虽然原文未披露具体性能测试数值，但定位上旨在超越现有竞品的用户体验。适用于追求极致开发效率、对工具链定制化有高度要求，且对 Conductor 或 Orca 等现有平台不满意的的专业开发者与技术团队。产品目前处于公开发布阶段，作者真诚邀请广大用户提出宝贵反馈，以推动产品的持续迭代与完善。
items.quote: 我开发了这个，因为对 conductor、orca 或其他 VS Code 衍生平台不满意。如果大家有什么反馈，请随时告诉我。
